title: Starship Reached Orbit. Next, SpaceX Tries to Catch It
dek: After a first orbital flight, SpaceX plans to catch both stages on Flight 15.
body: Flight 14 deployed 26 Starlink satellites on 28 September. Flight 15 is set for no earlier than 8 November.

panels.label: SpaceX Says
panels.text: Elon Musk says a catch of both stages is “more likely than not” and calls full reuse “a profound technology milestone.”

panels.label: Critics Say
panels.text: Mexican nonprofit Conibio Global says suspected Starship debris is washing onto Playa Bagdad and asks for an investigation.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: One side speaks of progress, the other of harm; at stake is who sets the terms for launches from a border coast.
